CustomField.description: Sequence number of the definition that must be completed before this one, within the group named by Blocked_By_Group_Letter__c (blank means this row own group). Blank means no prerequisite. Seeds Checklist_Item__c.Blocked_By__c at fan-out: B3 points at B2, I8 points at I7. THIS IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THE COLUMN - the Phase 0 gate on Task carries that pair map hardcoded in TaskFanoutService AND repeated in a backfill script, so adding a third prerequisite pair today means a code change in two places. With this column it becomes a definition edit and a loader re-run.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Sequence of the item that must be completed first, for example 2 on the B3 row. Leave blank when this item has no prerequisite.
CustomField.label: Blocked By Sequence
